source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references for identity, edition or revision, and scope. Official SEI records confirmed the ATAM report and evaluation outputs. Official ISO records confirmed ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 and ISO/IEC/IEEE 15026-2:2022 as published second editions; ISO reports ISO/IEC/IEEE 42020:2019 was confirmed in 2025 and entered revision status in 2026, so the chapter states both facts. Official NASA, GAO, and NIST pages confirmed the systems-engineering review, technology-readiness evidence, and trustworthy-systems records. Publisher records confirmed the Yin, Montgomery, and Toulmin editions. Mutable sources carry a 2026-09-06 retrieval date.

evidence: Reviewed driver, scenario, architecture, claim, evidence, finding, support relation, trace relation, validity assessment, architecture revision, evidence cutoff, and disposition notation before use.
Checked set comprehension, cardinality, subset, existential relation, and structural coverage expressions for GitHub-renderable syntax and defined zero-denominator boundary.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The chapter explicitly treats validity assessment as structured and contextual, not a universal scalar.

evidence: Recomputed the executable toy ledger as three critical claims, two with evidence identifiers, coverage 2/3=0.666666..., formatted 0.67, with C-RECOVERY unsupported.
Recomputed exercise structural coverage as four linked critical claims out of five, 4/5=0.8.
Checked the model-versus-test example: replacing optimistic assumptions yields a revised 8640 requests per second, which remains above the observed 8500 and is used only as a diagnostic comparison.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Coverage counts are structural indicators only; no percentage is presented as readiness, confidence, quality, or probability.

evidence: Verified every counted supported critical claim satisfies the existential evidence-link predicate in the definition of K.
Verified K is undefined when the critical-claim set is empty and the chapter restricts the formula to positive cardinality.
Verified the review trace relates drivers, scenarios, decisions, claims, evidence, and findings without asserting that a relation proves claim truth.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Structural completeness and evidential validity remain separate propositions.

evidence: Reviewed missing stakeholders, hierarchy-suppressed dissent, inaccessible participation, conflicts of interest, stale or forged evidence, shared evidence lineage, missing telemetry, unrepresentative tests, and invalid composition.
Reviewed zero incidents, rare failure, peak load, regional isolation, inconsistent state, emergency bypass, supplier change, cyberattack, funding pressure, alert fatigue, and model drift.

Reviewed advisory versus gate authority, conditional approval without enforcement, out-of-scope referrals, nondelegable constraints, closed tickets without evidence, and architecture revisions after review.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Safety, clinical, legal, privacy, accessibility, security, financial, and regulatory conclusions are referred to accountable specialist authorities.

evidence: Traced charter, baseline, drivers, scenarios, mechanisms, claims, artifacts, inference, findings, decisions, conditions, and closure throughout the procedure and examples.
Confirmed quantitative evidence retains definition, population, environment, unit, time, method, and uncertainty boundaries.
Confirmed every modeled outcome and condition preserves decision authority, dissent, expiry, closure evidence, and re-review triggers.
invariant_checking.notes: No document count, score, color, consensus, certification, or ticket state substitutes for claim-level reasoning.

evidence: Reviewed the counterexample in which K equals one while every claim cites the same invalid artifact, disproving any inference from structural coverage to truth.
Reviewed the mean-versus-percentile, component-versus-system, incident-absence, and certification-scope counterexamples for valid premise use.
Reviewed evidence-conflict reasoning in the capacity example and confirmed the revised prediction is not presented as proof of target capacity.
proof_review.notes: Arguments are bounded to recorded claims and evidence; the chapter makes no completeness, certification, or universal-correctness proof.

evidence: Audited uses of evidence, prove, support, valid, independent, current, confidence, ready, approve, assurance, complete, and correct for explicit scope.
Confirmed observation, inference, expert judgment, recommendation, accountable decision, condition, and certification remain distinct claim types.
Confirmed the hospital transfer answer expressly disclaims medical, safety, privacy, security, accessibility, legal, and regulatory approval.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No heuristic or ordinal classification is mislabeled as calibrated probability or formal proof.

evidence: Executed snippet critical-claim-coverage with the repository verifier under the recorded Python 3 toolchain.
Observed exit status 0, exact stdout for three critical claims, two supported claims, 0.67 structural coverage, and C-RECOVERY unsupported, with empty stderr.
The chapter and snippet state that identifier presence cannot assess evidence validity or claim truth.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution validates deterministic traversal and formatting for one toy ledger only; it does not validate a real review, evidence artifact, architecture, or decision.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed decision chartering, participants and independence, architecture baselining, evidence inventory, claims and mechanisms, evidence quality, measurements, experiments, models, production and incident evidence, suppliers, triangulation, facilitation, prioritization, findings, outcomes, closure, and reproducibility for conceptual coherence and separation from ATAM-specific coverage in SARCH-061.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed concrete review inputs, version and provenance controls, metric and experiment challenges, supplier scope, dissent handling, decision dispositions, enforceable conditions, traceable findings, access controls, closure evidence, and re-review triggers. The procedure remains usable for early candidate and deployed-system decisions without turning the review into a checklist score. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified graduate-depth review judgment, eighteen distinct misconceptions, one reproducible structural check with an intentional gap, ten varied worked examples with explicit conclusions, and five progressive exercises with complete answers ending in an unfamiliar hospital medication-workflow transfer problem.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed. Source checks, structural validation, claim-trace reasoning, and one local Python execution do not assess an external system, validate actual review evidence, establish statistical calibration, certify architecture or product readiness, or provide medical, clinical, safety, financial, legal, privacy, accessibility, security, procurement, public-service, or regulatory approval.
